Seat the child securely on the far dinette bench between the two parents, with head noticeably lower/smaller than the adults, smiling and pointing at the unlettered travel map on the table with one natural small hand. The child is part of a relaxed family interaction, not floating or standing on furniture. Make only the minimum seat/arm placement adjustment needed to give all three people believable space. Preserve both original adult identities, their olive/ivory casual clothes, cabin furniture, open doorway, dusk campsite, tent, lake/trees, warm lights and overall camera composition.
